verdict: Leads are coming in, but key seasonal buildout is overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 27 leads at $62.52 per lead across $1,688 in total ad spend, with Google Business Profile adding 121 organic actions — 15 calls and 75 direction requests — on top of paid results. A positive spike of 11 leads came in October 16–18, which is encouraging heading into heating season; however, lead tracking dropped to zero for the most recent 7-day window, so this week's efficiency cannot be fully confirmed while tracking is being repaired. Nine planned milestones — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and the LSA re-enable — are overdue by up to 80 days, and these gaps are the primary reason the account isn't yet scaled for peak season. Each of those items is being actively worked through, with the goal of having the most critical pieces resolved before the end of October.
